# Minnesota Environmental Health Association

> > MEHA is a professional association representing environmental health and public health professionals across Minnesota, offering conferences, awards, memberships, and career opportunities.

The Minnesota Environmental Health Association (MEHA) serves as the primary professional organization for environmental health practitioners in Minnesota. The site features membership programs, continuing education through conferences, professional recognition awards, and job postings for environmental health careers.
